gold_points: Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness dispenses prescriptions and provides ancillary services like diagnostic testing and vaccinations
Segment operated more than 9,000 retail locations as of December 31, 2024
Also runs long-term care pharmacy operations and fulfillment for Health Services segment
Corporate/Other holds management and administrative expenses plus products no longer sold, like large case pensions
output.note: Second chunk alone covers the question; the first chunk mostly overlaps and covers Health Services, which is not needed.
output.question: How did CVS Health describe the operations of its Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness segment and the content of its Corporate/Other segment in its fiscal year 2024 10-K?
